تعتصري (form VIII)
# تَعْتَصِرِي (taʕtaṣirī) /taʕ.ta.sˤi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# تُعْتَصَرِي (tuʕtaṣarī) /tuʕ.ta.sˤa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
